system.hook: Keeps volunteering for point man -1st thru the hatch
system.biography: Hunter from Wisconsin. Perfectionist. Steady as it gets. Family man with two toddlers whose names are tattooed over his heart. Deployed to Afghanistan, earning Achievement Medal with Valor. Trained Breacher. Recent promotion, transferred to squad - doesn't fully trust everyone yet.

system.description: Riflemen are the backbone of any military force, the essential soldier whose skills, endurance, and adaptability define the success of a patrol. In Outside the Wire, this archetype represents the foundation of military play as characters who are reliable, versatile, and always in the action’s thick. The Rifleman doesn’t lead from the map or issue orders from the rear; they’re the first in and the last out, shaping the fight through discipline, precision, and raw willpower. Every engagement, from street-to-street combat to jungle ambushes or desert patrols, relies on the Rifleman’s steadiness under fire.

Breacher School trains specialists to defeat obstacles, doors, walls, gates, or fortified structures, using mechanical, ballistic, thermal, and explosive methods. Students learn charge calculation, explosive placement, shockwave management, and team safety choreography. They rehearse entries under stress, coordinating with assault teams to ensure speed and precision during raids. Breachers train in structural assessment to avoid catastrophic overuse of force. In missions, breacher-trained characters are the key to cracking hidden bunkers, hostage compounds, or Improvised Explosive Device workshops, and their expertise can determine whether an entry is surgical or chaotic. Graduates of this school gain Explosives Expert +2 and the breacher kit.
